content.short: Hyperion is a high-performance decentralized exchange (DEX) on Aptos featuring a hybrid CLOB/AMM model.
content.description: Hyperion is a next-generation decentralized exchange built natively on the Aptos blockchain, designed to deliver a professional trading experience with sub-second latency. By employing a hybrid liquidity model that combines a Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) with Automated Market Maker (AMM) functionality, Hyperion offers the precision of a centralized exchange alongside the security of on-chain settlement. The platform leverages Aptos' high throughput to provide traders with advanced order types and deep liquidity for trading spot assets and derivatives.
